Sentence (English): Yes, the product itself is OK and of course quiet.
Comments (English): [ Failure to honor warranty ] || ---------------- || Yes, the product itself is OK and of course quiet. My problem is with the company denying my warranty claim. It started with a E17 code in month 3 of ownership which shut the washer down. I looked in the manual--the troubleshooting section of course -- and found codes , explanations, and suggestions on how to fix, every code up to E15. My luck. I looked further in the owners manual and it is clearly stated for code E17 to call for service. Nothing more. So I did and 5 days later the tech came and immediately fixed it without a tool. He could have been in and out in 5 minutes. I was happy to get it back in operation and didn't listen much as he explained that like so many other German designed products it was way over engineered, making it overly complicated, more prone to repairs, and expensive parts costs. In this washer's design the water is sent into a thin, small plastic box where it has a circuitous route before exiting. If the water pressure is too high it forces it up and into the sensor that thinks there's too much water inside the machine and shuts it down. Of course there was no such problem. To rectify it the service guy turned the hot water valve down until a happy medium was reached. End of repair. I wondered why Bosch couldn't have included this simple fix in their troubleshooting section especially when they have no intention of honoring a claim --in my case $125 service call charge! According to the repair center it falls under the heading "problems that can be blamed on the customer and not us". It is akin to Acts of God clauses that shift blame to other sources so many companies include in their warranty statements. Not their fault? In my opinion the design, their design, was flawed to allow a sensor to be placed where it could be easily tripped, sending a false diagnosis out and making the washer impotent.This is such an obvious case that could have been avoided I am truly amazed a company the size of Bosch would risk customers wrath and losing them forever like myself. It is an arrogant and short sided policy that is the staple of shady companies, a grouping they now find themselves aligned with, at least in my mind.Oh, and one last comment about the product itself. With their brilliant German engineering the idea to dry the dishes by super heating the water so it vaporizes the excess away is a fail because A) it simply doesn't work unless you open the door and leave it open after it finishes the last cycle and then go to bed and see your (mostly) dry dishes upon awakening 8 hours later B) Buried in the owners manual Bosch decides to admit it won't adequately dry the contents unless you spend more money on Rinse Aid. Finally they have one phone number to call for anything for any appliance from brochures to setting up service to manual downloads. This of course means you get to listen to the blatantly disingenuous message once again to deflect blame for such long wait times (31 minutes for me on one call) . Why do companies insist on insulting their customer's intelligence by forcing them to listen 57 times to the lie of "Your call is very important to us. " when they are too focussed on profits to hire more service reps.

He could have been in and out in 5 minutes. I was happy to get it back in operation and didn't listen much as he explained that like so many other German designed products it was way over engineered, making it overly complicated, more prone to repairs, and expensive parts costs. Sentence (English): I've been using the Series 6 dishwasher for around nine months and so far I'm very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Quiet device with practical comfort features ] || ---------------- || I've been using the Series 6 dishwasher for around nine months and so far I'm very happy with it. It is pleasantly quiet and cleans the dishes absolutely satisfactorily. I particularly like the cutlery drawer and the very flexible layout. However, the middle basket for large wine glasses cannot be adjusted downwards far enough so that their feet hit the cutlery drawer. I'm a big fan of Home Connect and so I also use the dishwasher with the app of the same name on my iPhone and Apple Watch. This is really practical, especially since you can create favorites so that you can then start the home appliances with the watch. Here I would still wish for the integration of Siri, which should be possible thanks to the app via the shortcuts. A very nice feature of the SBV6ZVC46E, in addition to the white interior lighting via LEDs, is the projection of the display onto the floor. I could have lived with a display on the front, but it's a very nice and discreet solution. Overall, I am very satisfied with the dishwasher and would recommend it at any time, just like any other household appliance that I own from BSH.
Comments (Original): [ Leises Gerät mit praktischen Comfort-Features ] || ---------------- || Ich nutze den Series 6 Geschirrspüler nun seit ca. einem dreiviertel Jahr und bin bisher sehr zufrieden mit ihm. Er ist angenehm leise und reinigt das Geschirr absolut zufriedenstellend. Besonders mag ich die Besteck-Schublade sowie die recht flexibel gestaltbare Aufteilung. Allerdings ist der mittlere Korb für große Weingläser nicht weit genug nach unten verstellbar, so dass sie mit ihren Füßenn an die Besteck-Schublade stoßen. Ich bin ein großer Anhänger von Home Connect und so nutze ich auch den Geschiirrspüler mit der gleichnamigen App auf meinem iPhone und der Apple Watch. Das ist wirklich praktisch, zumal man sich Favoriten anlegen kann, um darüber dann die Hausgeräte mit der Watch starten zu können. Hier würde ich mir noch die Intergration von Siri wünschen, was ja dank der App über die Kurzbefehle möglich sein sollte. Ein sehr schönes Feature am SBV6ZVC46E ist neben der weißen Innenraumbeleuchtung per LED auch noch die Projektion der Anzeige auf den Fußboden. Ich hätte hier zwar auch mit einem Display auf der Front leben können, aber so ist es sehr schön dezent gelöst. Insgesamt bin ich sehr zufrieden mit dem Geschirrspüler und würde ihn auch jederzeit weiter empfehlen, wie übrigens jedes andere Hausgerät, was ich von der BSH besitze.

I am very happy with my purchase, it makes my day-to-day life at home easier, I hope it lasts a long time and that everything continues well.

Sentence (English): I've been using the Series 6 dishwasher for around nine months and so far I'm very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Quiet device with practical comfort features ] || ---------------- || I've been using the Series 6 dishwasher for around nine months and so far I'm very happy with it. It is pleasantly quiet and cleans the dishes absolutely satisfactorily. I particularly like the cutlery drawer and the very flexible layout. However, the middle basket for large wine glasses cannot be adjusted downwards far enough so that their feet hit the cutlery drawer. I'm a big fan of Home Connect and so I also use the dishwasher with the app of the same name on my iPhone and Apple Watch. This is really practical, especially since you can create favorites so that you can then start the home appliances with the watch. Here I would still wish for the integration of Siri, which should be possible thanks to the app via the shortcuts. A very nice feature of the SBV6ZVC46E, in addition to the white interior lighting via LED, is the projection of the display onto the floor. I could have lived with a display on the front, but it's a very nice and discreet solution. Overall, I am very satisfied with the dishwasher and would recommend it at any time, just like any other household appliance that I own from BSH.
Comments (Original): [ Leises Gerät mit praktischen Comfort-Features ] || ---------------- || Ich nutze den Series 6 Geschirrspüler nun seit ca. einem dreiviertel Jahr und bin bisher sehr zufrieden mit ihm. Er ist angenehm leise und reinigt das Geschirr absolut zufriedenstellend. Besonders mag ich die Besteck-Schublade sowie die recht flexibel gestaltbare Aufteilung. Allerdings ist der mittlere Korb für große Weingläser nicht weit genug nach unten verstellbar, so dass sie mit ihren Füßenn an die Besteck-Schublade stoßen. Ich bin ein großer Anhänger von Home Connect und so nutze ich auch den Geschiirrspüler mit der gleichnamigen App auf meinem iPhone und der Apple Watch. Das ist wirklich praktisch, zumal man sich Favoriten anlegen kann, um darüber dann die Hausgeräte mit der Watch starten zu können. Hier würde ich mir noch die Intergration von Siri wünschen, was ja dank der App über die Kurzbefehle möglich sein sollte. Ein sehr schönes Feature am SBV6ZVC46E ist neben der weißen Innenraumbeleuchtung per LED auch noch die Projektion der Anzeige auf den Fußboden. Ich hätte hier zwar auch mit einem Display auf der Front leben können, aber so ist es sehr schön dezent gelöst. Insgesamt bin ich sehr zufrieden mit dem Geschirrspüler und würde ihn auch jederzeit weiter empfehlen, wie übrigens jedes andere Hausgerät, was ich von der BSH besitze.

Sentence (English): This is my third Bosch dishwasher, had no hesitation in choosing Bosch again as our previous two lasted 11 and 12 years.
Comments (English): [ DishwashBosch! ] || ---------------- || This is my third Bosch dishwasher, had no hesitation in choosing Bosch again as our previous two lasted 11 and 12 years. This one is an improvement on the previous one, it's quieter, more efficient with the programs, switches itself off when finished, I'm very happy with it. It has this Wi-Fi app enabled function that I did download just to see what the fuss is about. Essentially you can turn your machine on from wherever you are if you have Wi-Fi. I haven't used it for that. I usually turn the machine on when I load it and I'm standing right next to it. The app tells you when the program has finished. Not exactly a must have in my opinion but it has novelty value. I did use the app to set up my favourite program, but since then I've not used it and turned off notifications. I guess if I'd loaded the machine and closed the door properly, then gone out and realised I hadn't switched it on, it would be helpful to switch on from wherever I was, but so far I've managed to remember to switch it on when I've loaded. □□The dishwasher itself is great, I love it, it's an obvious improvement on the previous one. The express 65degree wash takes about 60 minutes and does a full load which is great. I can compare it to cheaper makes that I've used in holiday rentals etc and I prefer my Bosch.

Comments (English): [ At Last.  ] || ---------------- || I bought my first Bosch dishwasher years ago, and I loved it. I had use of it for several years, until I sold the house.Fast forward through several years of renting an apartment with no dishwasher, and finally buying an apartment which came with a functioning one (not Bosch). I was able to keep that machine operating for a couple of years, with the help of YouTube videos; however, it finally bit the dust. My new Bosch is even better than I had hoped. My apartment is tiny, yet I still can't hear the machine running, unless I'm standing right in front of it (even then, just barely). Everything I put in it comes out beautifully clean, spotless and as dry as I would expect. (Plastic storage containers and lids do retain some water, but I don't find that to be an issue. Those can be placed on a drying mat for a bit.) The silverware rack, which didn't exist when I had my first Bosch, is terrific. I can actually put everything straight from the dishwasher into the drawer without having to inspect for spots. I am hoping for a long, happy relationship.

I had use of it for several years, until I sold the house.Fast forward through several years of renting an apartment with no dishwasher, and finally buying an apartment which came with a functioning one (not Bosch). I was able to keep that machine operating for a couple of years, with the help of YouTube videos; however, it finally bit the dust. My new Bosch is even better than I had hoped. My apartment is tiny, yet I still can't hear the machine running, unless I'm standing right in front of it (even then, just barely). Everything I put in it comes out beautifully clean, spotless and as dry as I would expect. (Plastic storage containers and lids do retain some water, but I don't find that to be an issue. Those can be placed on a drying mat for a bit.) The silverware rack, which didn't exist when I had my first Bosch, is terrific. I can actually put everything straight from the dishwasher into the drawer without having to inspect for spots. I am hoping for a long, happy relationship.

Minor issue, but annoying.

Comments (English): I love this dishwasher! We have been using it for about 2 months now and I have no complaints. It seems huge inside and is easy to load/unload. I have not had that issue since getting this dishwasher. I would not say it is very loud (before the Bosch we had a Maytag that sounded like a jet taking off when it ran), but you can hear it running. It is like low white noise in the background, and does not bother me, but it is worth noting if you are looking for something very quiet.

Sentence (English): Advised by a seller, the reviews of some users and the comparisons of some publications such as the OCU, we decided to give this brand a chance, practically unknown to us to date.
Comments (English): Advised by a seller, the reviews of some users and the comparisons of some publications such as the OCU, we decided to give this brand a chance, practically unknown to us to date. At first it seemed to us to be a more than acceptable appliance in the relationship between qualities, functions, efficiency and price, but certain comments and opinions made us doubt whether to decide on this brand or choose others with more weight at the national level, even knowing that some of they had not gone well for us in other appliances. We finally chose this dishwasher and so far it's working really well. The additional programs and functions are easily selectable, with less or more time, temperature and water to be used, which results in final energy expenditure and washing efficiency. The fact that you can set the wash for 60 and 30 minutes is a success, as is the choice of temperature depending on the type of dishes to be washed, without forgetting the additional functions, depending on the type of finish you want to do, drying or even washing trays and pots with greater dirt. In this last aspect, the dishwasher has an additional injector/sprinkler (Deepwash) designed for washing household items, which, although it is a plus, does not finish doing an optimal job unless a manual pre-wash is carried out beforehand and the more encrusted dirt. Another aspect to review is the aesthetic. With a quite successful brushed stainless steel exterior finish and gray plastic trims, which tops off a very intuitive touch display and which, in the case of my unit, has not caused any problems when pressed, except for those indicated in the manual in case of incompatibility of functions. and programs. In this regard, note that not all programs are compatible with all functions and that not all functions can be activated at the same time, including the automatic door opening function at the end of the wash, which is not available in all programs either. . As for the interior finish, it has a correct stainless steel bucket, with a lower sprinkler designed to reach all corners of the device and a wide upper sprinkler, which does its job well. The fact that it has a third tray for cutlery is something that we were reluctant to do at first, but it has ended up being very practical for us due to the cleanliness it obtains in the cutlery and the space it leaves free in the lower basket to optimize space by not carry the typical cutlery basket. But in relation to the arrangement of the trays, although the upper one is adjustable in height, we have noticed that wine glasses of a certain size do not fit or do so with difficulty, in which the cutlery tray prevents them from entering as they should . What Beko should improve on, without a doubt, is the quality controls, since our unit came with a small bump on the upper right side, which was also marked with a black marker, as if it had actually passed those controls and they had given the "go-ahead" but with this small flaw, which although it does not interfere with the operation of the appliance and is completely hidden by the kitchen counter, it is strange for the buyer to find this type of thing. However, ignoring these small defects, I consider the dishwasher totally recommendable for now, waiting to see how it stands the test of time.
Comments (Original): [ Buena relación calidad/precio ] || ---------------- || Aconsejados por algún vendedor, las reseñas de algunos usuarios y las comparativas de algunas publicaciones como la OCU, decidimos dar una oportunidad a esta marca, prácticamente desconocida para nosotros hasta la fecha.De principio nos pareció un electrodoméstico más que aceptable en la relación entre calidades, funciones, eficiencia y precio, pero ciertos comentarios y opiniones nos hacían dudar si decidirnos por esta marca o elegir otras con más peso a nivel nacional, aún a sabiendas que alguna de ellas no nos había ido del todo bien en otros electrodomésticos.Finalmente elegimos este lavavajillas y por ahora está funcionando francamente bien. Los programas y funciones adicionales son fácilmente seleccionables, con menor o mayor tiempo, temperatura y agua a utilizar, lo que redunda en el gasto energético final y en la eficacia del lavado. Que se pueda configurar el lavado de 60 y 30 minutos es todo un acierto, así como la elección de la temperatura en función al tipo de vajilla que se debe lavar, sin olvidar las funciones adicionales, dependiendo del tipo de acabado que se quiera realizar, el secado o incluso el lavado de bandejas y ollas con mayor suciedad.En este último aspecto, el lavavajillas dispone de un inyector/aspersor (Deepwash) adicional pensado para el lavado de menaje, que si bien es un plus, no termina de realizar un trabajo óptimo sino se hace un prelavado manual con anterioridad y se elimina la suciedad más incrustada.Otro aspecto a reseñar es el estético. Con un acabado exterior inoxidable cepillado bastante logrado y embellecedores de plástico gris, que remata un display táctil muy intuitivo y que en el caso de mi unidad no ha dado ningún problema al pulsarlo, salvo los que indica el manual por el caso de incompatibilidad de funciones y programas.Señalar en este sentido que no todos los programas son compatibles con todas las funciones y que no todas las funciones se pueden activar a la vez, incluyendo la función de la apertura de puerta automática al finalizar el lavado, que tampoco está disponible en todos los programas.En cuanto al acabado interior, cuenta con una cubeta de acero inoxidable correcta, con un aspersor inferior pensado para llegar a todos los rincones del aparato y un aspersor superior ancho, que realiza bien su labor.Que cuente con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos es algo a lo que en principio éramos reacios, pero que ha terminado por resultarnos muy práctico por la limpieza que obtiene en la cubertería y el hueco que deja libre en la cesta inferior para optimizar el espacio al no llevar el típico cestillo de cubiertos.Pero en lo relativo a la disposición de las bandejas, aunque regulable en altura la superior, sí hemos notado que no caben o lo hacen con dificultad las copas de vino de cierta envergadura, en las que la bandeja de cubiertos impiden que éstas entren como deberían.En lo que sí debería mejorar Beko, sin duda, es los controles de calidad, ya que nuestra unidad venía con un pequeño golpe en el lateral derecho superior, que además venía marcado con rotulador negro, como si efectivamente hubiera pasado esos controles y le hubieran dado el 'visto bueno' pero con esta pequeña tara, que aunque no interfieren en el funcionamiento del aparato y queda totalmente escondido por la encimera de la cocina, sí que resulta extraño para el comprador encontrarse este tipo de cosas.No obstante, obviando estos pequeños defectos, el lavavajillas lo considero totalmente recomendable por ahora, a la espera de ver cómo resiste el paso del tiempo.

At first it seemed to us to be a more than acceptable appliance in the relationship between qualities, functions, efficiency and price, but certain comments and opinions made us doubt whether to decide on this brand or choose others with more weight at the national level, even knowing that some of they had not gone well for us in other appliances. We finally chose this dishwasher and so far it's working really well. The additional programs and functions are easily selectable, with less or more time, temperature and water to be used, which results in final energy expenditure and washing efficiency. The fact that you can set the wash for 60 and 30 minutes is a success, as is the choice of temperature depending on the type of dishes to be washed, without forgetting the additional functions, depending on the type of finish you want to do, drying or even washing trays and pots with greater dirt. In this last aspect, the dishwasher has an additional injector/sprinkler (Deepwash) designed for washing household items, which, although it is a plus, does not finish doing an optimal job unless a manual pre-wash is carried out beforehand and the more encrusted dirt. Another aspect to review is the aesthetic. With a quite successful brushed stainless steel exterior finish and gray plastic trims, which tops off a very intuitive touch display and which, in the case of my unit, has not caused any problems when pressed, except for those indicated in the manual in case of incompatibility of functions. and programs. In this regard, note that not all programs are compatible with all functions and that not all functions can be activated at the same time, including the automatic door opening function at the end of the wash, which is not available in all programs either. . As for the interior finish, it has a correct stainless steel bucket, with a lower sprinkler designed to reach all corners of the device and a wide upper sprinkler, which does its job well. The fact that it has a third tray for cutlery is something that we were reluctant to do at first, but it has ended up being very practical for us due to the cleanliness it obtains in the cutlery and the space it leaves free in the lower basket to optimize space by not carry the typical cutlery basket. But in relation to the arrangement of the trays, although the upper one is adjustable in height, we have noticed that wine glasses of a certain size do not fit or do so with difficulty, in which the cutlery tray prevents them from entering as they should . What Beko should improve on, without a doubt, is the quality controls, since our unit came with a small bump on the upper right side, which was also marked with a black marker, as if it had actually passed those controls and they had given the "go-ahead" but with this small flaw, which although it does not interfere with the operation of the appliance and is completely hidden by the kitchen counter, it is strange for the buyer to find this type of thing. However, ignoring these small defects, I consider the dishwasher totally recommendable for now, waiting to see how it stands the test of time.
Comments (Original): [ Buena relación calidad/precio ] || ---------------- || Aconsejados por algún vendedor, las reseñas de algunos usuarios y las comparativas de algunas publicaciones como la OCU, decidimos dar una oportunidad a esta marca, prácticamente desconocida para nosotros hasta la fecha.De principio nos pareció un electrodoméstico más que aceptable en la relación entre calidades, funciones, eficiencia y precio, pero ciertos comentarios y opiniones nos hacían dudar si decidirnos por esta marca o elegir otras con más peso a nivel nacional, aún a sabiendas que alguna de ellas no nos había ido del todo bien en otros electrodomésticos.Finalmente elegimos este lavavajillas y por ahora está funcionando francamente bien. Los programas y funciones adicionales son fácilmente seleccionables, con menor o mayor tiempo, temperatura y agua a utilizar, lo que redunda en el gasto energético final y en la eficacia del lavado. Que se pueda configurar el lavado de 60 y 30 minutos es todo un acierto, así como la elección de la temperatura en función al tipo de vajilla que se debe lavar, sin olvidar las funciones adicionales, dependiendo del tipo de acabado que se quiera realizar, el secado o incluso el lavado de bandejas y ollas con mayor suciedad.En este último aspecto, el lavavajillas dispone de un inyector/aspersor (Deepwash) adicional pensado para el lavado de menaje, que si bien es un plus, no termina de realizar un trabajo óptimo sino se hace un prelavado manual con anterioridad y se elimina la suciedad más incrustada.Otro aspecto a reseñar es el estético. Con un acabado exterior inoxidable cepillado bastante logrado y embellecedores de plástico gris, que remata un display táctil muy intuitivo y que en el caso de mi unidad no ha dado ningún problema al pulsarlo, salvo los que indica el manual por el caso de incompatibilidad de funciones y programas.Señalar en este sentido que no todos los programas son compatibles con todas las funciones y que no todas las funciones se pueden activar a la vez, incluyendo la función de la apertura de puerta automática al finalizar el lavado, que tampoco está disponible en todos los programas.En cuanto al acabado interior, cuenta con una cubeta de acero inoxidable correcta, con un aspersor inferior pensado para llegar a todos los rincones del aparato y un aspersor superior ancho, que realiza bien su labor.Que cuente con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos es algo a lo que en principio éramos reacios, pero que ha terminado por resultarnos muy práctico por la limpieza que obtiene en la cubertería y el hueco que deja libre en la cesta inferior para optimizar el espacio al no llevar el típico cestillo de cubiertos.Pero en lo relativo a la disposición de las bandejas, aunque regulable en altura la superior, sí hemos notado que no caben o lo hacen con dificultad las copas de vino de cierta envergadura, en las que la bandeja de cubiertos impiden que éstas entren como deberían.En lo que sí debería mejorar Beko, sin duda, es los controles de calidad, ya que nuestra unidad venía con un pequeño golpe en el lateral derecho superior, que además venía marcado con rotulador negro, como si efectivamente hubiera pasado esos controles y le hubieran dado el 'visto bueno' pero con esta pequeña tara, que aunque no interfieren en el funcionamiento del aparato y queda totalmente escondido por la encimera de la cocina, sí que resulta extraño para el comprador encontrarse este tipo de cosas.No obstante, obviando estos pequeños defectos, el lavavajillas lo considero totalmente recomendable por ahora, a la espera de ver cómo resiste el paso del tiempo.

Los programas y funciones adicionales son fácilmente seleccionables, con menor o mayor tiempo, temperatura y agua a utilizar, lo que redunda en el gasto energético final y en la eficacia del lavado. pulsarlo, salvo los que indica el manual por el caso de incompatibilidad de funciones y programas.Señalar en este sentido que no todos los programas son compatibles con todas las funciones y que no todas las funciones se pueden activar a la vez, incluyendo la función de la apertura de puerta automática al finalizar el lavado, que tampoco está disponible en todos los programas.En cuanto al labor.Que cuente con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos es algo a lo que en principio éramos reacios, pero que ha terminado por resultarnos muy práctico por la limpieza que obtiene en la cubertería y el hueco que deja libre en la cesta inferior para optimizar el espacio al no llevar el típico cestillo de cubiertos.Pero en lo relativo a la disposición de las bandejas, aunque regulable en altura la superior, sí hemos notado que no caben o lo hacen con dificultad las copas de vino de cierta envergadura, en las que la bandeja de cubiertos impiden que éstas entren como deberían.En lo que sí debería la encimera de la cocina, sí que resulta extraño para el comprador encontrarse este tipo de cosas.No obstante, obviando estos pequeños defectos, el lavavajillas lo considero totalmente recomendable por ahora, a la espera de ver cómo resiste el paso del tiempo.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is a good model for customers who like it very quiet, don't need a lot of bells and whistles and can tinker a little with dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Tut was sie soll - aber reparaturanfällig ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is a good model for customers who like it very quiet, don't need a lot of bells and whistles and can tinker a little with dishwashers.Basically, the machine does exactly what you buy it for - crockery, glasses, cutlery, pots and pans if necessary Pans can be cleaned with the right cleaning agent. It is a pleasantly quiet device, especially in open kitchens. Unfortunately, the problems with our device began after just under 1.5 years. The left pulley of the door resistance cable broke so that the door simply fell down when the machine was opened. A warranty repair was able to remedy the situation, but the same problem appeared on the other side almost six months later (this time outside the warranty period). Annoying and after a lot of fiddling, you could solve this yourself. But another month later, we noticed that not only all the door seals but also the pump sump seal were slowly disintegrating, so that it was constantly dripping under the machine in the electronics area. Since I didn't want to tackle the electronics myself, we called a technician and described the problems. A repair would have cost around EUR 350-400 due to the expensive sets of spare parts. Of course, it's possible that we had a lot of bad luck with our Sunday machine, but during our research we often read that "water-bearing devices" from SAMSUNG aren't exactly included shine for a long time. The technician's recommendation was definitely in the direction of Siemens. But if you bring the desire, time and tinkering skills, this is a fairly inexpensive device that (at least in the medium term) does what it's supposed to do. Conclusion: No purchase recommendation - but better than nothing.
Comments (Original): [ Tut was sie soll - aber reparaturanfällig ] || ---------------- || Die Spülmaschine ist ein gutes Modell für Kunden, die es gerne sehr leise haben, keinen großen Schnick-schnack brauchen und ein wenig an Spülmaschinen basteln können.Grundsätzlich macht die Maschine genau das, wofür man sie anschafft - Geschirr, Gläser, Besteck, Töpfe und bei Bedarf Pfannen werden mit dem richtigen Reiniger sauber. Sie ist gerade bei offenen Küchen ein angenehm leises Gerät.Bei unserem Gerät fingen die Probleme allerdings leider bereits nach knapp 1,5 Jahren an. Die linke Umlenkrolle vom Seilzug des Türwiderstandes brach, sodass die Tür beim Öffnen der Maschine einfach nach unten fiel. Eine Garantiereparatur konnte zwar Abhilfe verschaffen, allerdings trat das selbe Problem auf der anderen Seite ein knappes halbes Jahr später auch auf (Diesmal außerhalb der Garantiezeit). Ärgerlich und nach viel Fummelei, konnte man dies selber lösen. Doch einen weiteren Monat später, stellten wir fest, dass sich nicht nur sämtliche Türdichtungen sondern auch die Pumpensumpfdichtung langsam auflösten, sodass es unter der Maschine in den Bereich der Elektronik stetig tropfte. Da ich mich selber an die Elektronik nicht heran trauen wollte, haben wir einen Techniker bestellt und die Probleme geschildert. Eine Reparatur hätte aufgrund der teuren Ersatzteilesets ca. 350-400 EUR gekostet.Jetzt kann es natürlich sein, dass wir sehr viel Pech bei unserer Sonntagsmaschine hatten, allerdings haben wir bei unseren Recherchen öfters gelesen, dass 'wasserführende Geräte' von SAMSUNG nicht gerade mit langer Lebensdauer glänzen. Die Empfehlung des Techniker ging auf jeden Fall in Richtung Siemens.Wenn man aber Lust, Zeit und Bastelvermögen mitbringt ist dies ein recht günstiges Gerät, welches (zumindest mittelfristig) tut, was es soll.Fazit: Keine Kaufempfehlung - aber besser als nix.

Comments (English): [ Powerhouse of a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We have owned this dishwasher for about four months now and have been very satisfied with it.As a luxury appliance, this one doesn't disappoint. Would totally recommend for anyone looking for a high end, superior functioning known brand appliance. Bosch is it!

Sentence (English): Our 17 year old Jenn-Air died on Christmas Eve with a house full of guests and a dishwasher full of dirty dishes, so we took what we could get in a hurry.
Comments (English): Our 17 year old Jenn-Air died on Christmas Eve with a house full of guests and a dishwasher full of dirty dishes, so we took what we could get in a hurry. The price is steep, but the machine works as advertised. We tried letting scrambled eggs dry on dishes for a couple days, and we tried melted-on cheese. The Jenn-Air couldn't touch that stuff (other than to bake it on during the dry cycle), but the Bosch got rid of everything. There is also a zeolite catalyst assisted dry cycle that I don't understand, but it works. Bosch advertises a 42 dB(A) noise level, and I'm a noise & vibration engineer, so I checked. Standing 3 feet in front of the machine, I measured 38 dB most of the time, with occasional excursions to 42 dB. It's so quiet you often have to look for the red light shining on the floor to make sure it's running. The loudest sound in the whole cycle is when it drains water, and then all you hear is water running into the sink drain. You can't hear the dishwasher's pump. If it stays in one piece, we'll be very happy.

I'm sure it used a couple extra gallons of water but less electricity because the minimum these new machines run is an hour. Sentence (English): Do NOT buy this.
Comments (English): Do NOT buy this. Furious with Whirlpool for producing such a cheap innefective product. The only thing positive you could say about it is it isn't terribly loud and the dishes get clean. No one should have to buy a product and be expected to buy extra products or put toxic chemicals in their system (as if we aren't exposed to enough) to try to get dry dishes. The heated dry needs to run for several minutes longer as well as an option to run again. Every piece of silverware bowl mug that isn't angled, and lid are almost always coated in water. Plates is the only are that dries. You have to leave the door open half a day if you don't feel like hand drying or sticking moist silverware into the drawer or turn everything over in the sink drying rack to put up later.Bought in early spring 2022 would have immediarely returned if I had been cooking more at home. Have gotten really fed up after 6 months of this crap. Now I have to try to find a non toxic solution. Health wise I don't have enough time energy for nonsense like this it is absolutely an abusive consumer experience since I would literally have to buy a new dishwasher for it to be functional and there isn't any warning given that you will need to now purchase more items for the entirety of the product to make it work as it as advertised.Forgot to say it isn't just wet dishes! You absolutely have to leave it open for hours because every surface is covered in water as well as tiny pools of water gathering all over, especially covering the door and bottom. So annoying. It's definitely plenty enough to be concerned about mold.For over $500 with tax and the large cost to have to have it installed, I should be able to receive a product that works without a headache and frustration. Our Whirlpool growing up was great, this is garbage. Will never trust them again.

Sentence (English): After reading a lot of introductions, I finally believed in the brand of Siemens.
Comments (English): After reading a lot of introductions, I finally believed in the brand of Siemens. I bought all the electrical appliances in the new house on JD. The delivery of the others was fast. The dishwasher arrived two days late. The installer was good and I even visited the site in advance. Can it be installed? After unpacking the goods, the installation master found that the unicorn arm was broken and the door could not be closed. The master also said that the imported things are not even protected, and the transportation is easy to cause problems. I am the unlucky one. . The installation master opened the order, I contacted the customer service, and then got stuck in the supplier review for 3 days. I asked the customer service of the purchase and said that this order has been upgraded to Jingdong customer service. Let me contact Jingdong. It was really fast when I bought it, and it was returned (I guess it might be because of Saturday and Sunday). The worst thing was that the replacement machine was unpacked and checked by the installer. There was no problem with the door and other accessories. Installation, the master took a lot of effort to press it, started the test machine, but it didn’t work, and a fault code appeared, the installer said, it’s over, and opened the order again. Really lost faith in this brand. Originally imported, why?
Comments (Original): 看了好多介绍，最终相信西门子的品牌，新房子所有电器都在京东一起买的，其他的送货很快，这个洗碗机是晚两天到的，安装师傅不错，还提前来看了现场能不能安装，到货后安装师傅拆箱就发现麒麟臂断了，门关不上，师傅还说进口的东西连个保护都没有运输容易出问题，我就是那个倒霉蛋，没办法换货吧。安装师傅开单子，我联系客服，然后竟然卡在供应商审核3天，问购买的客服说这个订单升级到京东客服了，让我联系京东，我打京东客服就让我等，说尽快处理，真是买的时候很快，退换就（我猜想有可能是因为周六周日的关系），最糟心的是换的机器安装师傅拆箱检查，门也没问题，其他配件也没问题，开始安装，师傅费了好大功夫按上了，开机试机，竟然不运行，出现故障代码，安装师傅说，完了，又的开单子了。真的对这个品牌失去信心了。原装进口的啊，为什么？

Sentence (English): We purchased this product from a brick and mortar store in early December to replace an old machine by another brand.
Comments (English): We purchased this product from a brick and mortar store in early December to replace an old machine by another brand. Installed before Christmas and didn't work. We called the retailor after several attempts, following the instruction manual (which is only a few pages long); they sent an installer to check to see if it was properly hooked up, which it was. We again contact the retailor who sent a replacement from Bosch, which was installed today. The installer hooked it up this morning upon delivery, started it and left. It was still running when I returned from work at 5pm; I opened the door and found no evidence of water coming into the machine; nor did the cleaning capsule receptical open. Just got off the phone with Bosch customer service. He tried to do what I assume to be a factory reset and nothing. He has contacted a local distributer to come out and get it running for us. It shouldn't be this hard. Perhaps the instruction manual needs a rewrite to include actual guidance in operating. I frankly wish we had just gone ahead and paid $400 for a new computer board for the old machine. This is my first Bosch. I was expecting much better.

Sentence (English): We have six major LG appliances.
Comments (English): We have six major LG appliances. In the first week of November 2022 we took delivery of a brand new LG dishwasher, bought at the Brick in Ottawa. Within a month of the professional installation the motor failed completely and during the same cycle water and steam were evacuated directly into the kitchen over the top of the instrument panel. A technician came a week or so later and replaced the motor under warranty, but the leaking now persisted with every cycle we ran afterwards. The LG approved technician returned and replaced the entire interior of the door and the gasket. When we tested the machine that night (30th of December) we had a major leak that left a pool of water on the floor about 6' long by a 1' wide and a couple of millimetres deep. I immediately made it clear to LG that while we were disappointed the only thing we wanted at that point was a return of the machine and a refund of our money. Today (the 11th of January) I was contacted by a case manager by LG who basically offered us an ultimatum to either accept a third visit from their technician to try and repair this machine, or that we were on our own to pursue them legally. My wife and I have never in 28 years together a) had a brand new appliance fail this miserably and b) be treated so poorly by the corporation. This machine has been the worst major appliance purchase of our lives and we will never again buy a LG product. Their attitude since we started complaining has been very clear; they are very content to inconvenience the consumer and draw out the warranty experience, even if the machine is sitting idle most of the time. It was very clear to me today that the case manager simply wanted me to lose my patience and go on record as refusing yet another visit so that we would simply absorb the $1000 loss. It is clear that as a giant corporation they feel they are untouchable by individual clients.

In other words some dishes and cutlery stayed in the dishwasher a few days until running the dishwasher. We did not use a pre rinse or quick wash cycle. Lo and behold, the dishes are clean and sparkling, and did not require additional cleaning. We ran the dishwasher when we had hot water at the kitchen sink faucet and used cascade plus pods without additional rinse agent.

Sentence (English): Advised by a seller, the reviews of some users and the comparisons of some publications such as the OCU, we decided to give this brand a chance, practically unknown to us to date.
Comments (English): Advised by a seller, the reviews of some users and the comparisons of some publications such as the OCU, we decided to give this brand a chance, practically unknown to us to date. At first it seemed to us to be a more than acceptable appliance in the relationship between qualities, functions, efficiency and price, but certain comments and opinions made us doubt whether to decide on this brand or choose others with more weight at the national level, even knowing that some of they had not gone well for us in other appliances. We finally chose this dishwasher and so far it's working really well. The additional programs and functions are easily selectable, with less or more time, temperature and water to be used, which results in final energy expenditure and washing efficiency. The fact that you can set the wash for 60 and 30 minutes is a success, as is the choice of temperature depending on the type of dishes to be washed, without forgetting the additional functions, depending on the type of finish you want to do, drying or even washing trays and pots with greater dirt. In this last aspect, the dishwasher has an additional injector/sprinkler (Deepwash) designed for washing household items, which, although it is a plus, does not finish doing an optimal job unless a manual pre-wash is carried out beforehand and the more encrusted dirt. Another aspect to review is the aesthetic. With a quite successful brushed stainless steel exterior finish and gray plastic trims, which tops off a very intuitive touch display and which, in the case of my unit, has not caused any problems when pressed, except for those indicated in the manual in case of incompatibility of functions. and programs. In this regard, note that not all programs are compatible with all functions and that not all functions can be activated at the same time, including the automatic door opening function at the end of the wash, which is not available in all programs either. . As for the interior finish, it has a correct stainless steel bucket, with a lower sprinkler designed to reach all corners of the device and a wide upper sprinkler, which does its job well. The fact that it has a third tray for cutlery is something that we were reluctant to do at first, but it has ended up being very practical for us due to the cleanliness it obtains in the cutlery and the space it leaves free in the lower basket to optimize space by not carry the typical cutlery basket. But in relation to the arrangement of the trays, although the upper one is adjustable in height, we have noticed that wine glasses of a certain size do not fit or do so with difficulty, in which the cutlery tray prevents them from entering as they should . What Beko should improve on, without a doubt, is the quality controls, since our unit came with a small bump on the upper right side, which was also marked with a black marker, as if it had actually passed those controls and they had given the "go-ahead" but with this small defect, which although it does not interfere with the operation of the appliance and is completely hidden by the kitchen counter, it is indeed strange for the buyer to find this type of thing. However, ignoring these small defects, I consider the dishwasher totally recommendable for now, waiting to see how it stands the test of time.
Comments (Original): [ Buena relación calidad/precio ] || ---------------- || Aconsejados por algún vendedor, las reseñas de algunos usuarios y las comparativas de algunas publicaciones como la OCU, decidimos dar una oportunidad a esta marca, prácticamente desconocida para nosotros hasta la fecha.De principio nos pareció un electrodoméstico más que aceptable en la relación entre calidades, funciones, eficiencia y precio, pero ciertos comentarios y opiniones nos hacían dudar si decidirnos por esta marca o elegir otras con más peso a nivel nacional, aún a sabiendas que alguna de ellas no nos había ido del todo bien en otros electrodomésticos.Finalmente elegimos este lavavajillas y por ahora está funcionando francamente bien. Los programas y funciones adicionales son fácilmente seleccionables, con menor o mayor tiempo, temperatura y agua a utilizar, lo que redunda en el gasto energético final y en la eficacia del lavado. Que se pueda configurar el lavado de 60 y 30 minutos es todo un acierto, así como la elección de la temperatura en función al tipo de vajilla que se debe lavar, sin olvidar las funciones adicionales, dependiendo del tipo de acabado que se quiera realizar, el secado o incluso el lavado de bandejas y ollas con mayor suciedad.En este último aspecto, el lavavajillas dispone de un inyector/aspersor (Deepwash) adicional pensado para el lavado de menaje, que si bien es un plus, no termina de realizar un trabajo óptimo sino se hace un prelavado manual con anterioridad y se elimina la suciedad más incrustada.Otro aspecto a reseñar es el estético. Con un acabado exterior inoxidable cepillado bastante logrado y embellecedores de plástico gris, que remata un display táctil muy intuitivo y que en el caso de mi unidad no ha dado ningún problema al pulsarlo, salvo los que indica el manual por el caso de incompatibilidad de funciones y programas.Señalar en este sentido que no todos los programas son compatibles con todas las funciones y que no todas las funciones se pueden activar a la vez, incluyendo la función de la apertura de puerta automática al finalizar el lavado, que tampoco está disponible en todos los programas.En cuanto al acabado interior, cuenta con una cubeta de acero inoxidable correcta, con un aspersor inferior pensado para llegar a todos los rincones del aparato y un aspersor superior ancho, que realiza bien su labor.Que cuente con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos es algo a lo que en principio éramos reacios, pero que ha terminado por resultarnos muy práctico por la limpieza que obtiene en la cubertería y el hueco que deja libre en la cesta inferior para optimizar el espacio al no llevar el típico cestillo de cubiertos.Pero en lo relativo a la disposición de las bandejas, aunque regulable en altura la superior, sí hemos notado que no caben o lo hacen con dificultad las copas de vino de cierta envergadura, en las que la bandeja de cubiertos impiden que éstas entren como deberían.En lo que sí debería mejorar Beko, sin duda, es los controles de calidad, ya que nuestra unidad venía con un pequeño golpe en el lateral derecho superior, que además venía marcado con rotulador negro, como si efectivamente hubiera pasado esos controles y le hubieran dado el 'visto bueno' pero con esta pequeña tara, que aunque no interfieren en el funcionamiento del aparato y queda totalmente escondido por la encimera de la cocina, sí que resulta extraño para el comprador encontrarse este tipo de cosas.No obstante, obviando estos pequeños defectos, el lavavajillas lo considero totalmente recomendable por ahora, a la espera de ver cómo resiste el paso del tiempo.

At first it seemed to us to be a more than acceptable appliance in the relationship between qualities, functions, efficiency and price, but certain comments and opinions made us doubt whether to decide on this brand or choose others with more weight at the national level, even knowing that some of they had not gone well for us in other appliances. We finally chose this dishwasher and so far it's working really well. The additional programs and functions are easily selectable, with less or more time, temperature and water to be used, which results in final energy expenditure and washing efficiency. The fact that you can set the wash for 60 and 30 minutes is a success, as is the choice of temperature depending on the type of dishes to be washed, without forgetting the additional functions, depending on the type of finish you want to do, drying or even washing trays and pots with greater dirt. In this last aspect, the dishwasher has an additional injector/sprinkler (Deepwash) designed for washing household items, which, although it is a plus, does not finish doing an optimal job unless a manual pre-wash is carried out beforehand and the more encrusted dirt. Another aspect to review is the aesthetic. With a quite successful brushed stainless steel exterior finish and gray plastic trims, which tops off a very intuitive touch display and which, in the case of my unit, has not caused any problems when pressed, except for those indicated in the manual in case of incompatibility of functions. and programs. In this regard, note that not all programs are compatible with all functions and that not all functions can be activated at the same time, including the automatic door opening function at the end of the wash, which is not available in all programs either. . As for the interior finish, it has a correct stainless steel bucket, with a lower sprinkler designed to reach all corners of the device and a wide upper sprinkler, which does its job well. The fact that it has a third tray for cutlery is something that we were reluctant to do at first, but it has ended up being very practical for us due to the cleanliness it obtains in the cutlery and the space it leaves free in the lower basket to optimize space by not carry the typical cutlery basket. But in relation to the arrangement of the trays, although the upper one is adjustable in height, we have noticed that wine glasses of a certain size do not fit or do so with difficulty, in which the cutlery tray prevents them from entering as they should . What Beko should improve on, without a doubt, is the quality controls, since our unit came with a small bump on the upper right side, which was also marked with a black marker, as if it had actually passed those controls and they had given the "go-ahead" but with this small defect, which although it does not interfere with the operation of the appliance and is completely hidden by the kitchen counter, it is indeed strange for the buyer to find this type of thing. However, ignoring these small defects, I consider the dishwasher totally recommendable for now, waiting to see how it stands the test of time.
Comments (Original): [ Buena relación calidad/precio ] || ---------------- || Aconsejados por algún vendedor, las reseñas de algunos usuarios y las comparativas de algunas publicaciones como la OCU, decidimos dar una oportunidad a esta marca, prácticamente desconocida para nosotros hasta la fecha.De principio nos pareció un electrodoméstico más que aceptable en la relación entre calidades, funciones, eficiencia y precio, pero ciertos comentarios y opiniones nos hacían dudar si decidirnos por esta marca o elegir otras con más peso a nivel nacional, aún a sabiendas que alguna de ellas no nos había ido del todo bien en otros electrodomésticos.Finalmente elegimos este lavavajillas y por ahora está funcionando francamente bien. Los programas y funciones adicionales son fácilmente seleccionables, con menor o mayor tiempo, temperatura y agua a utilizar, lo que redunda en el gasto energético final y en la eficacia del lavado. Que se pueda configurar el lavado de 60 y 30 minutos es todo un acierto, así como la elección de la temperatura en función al tipo de vajilla que se debe lavar, sin olvidar las funciones adicionales, dependiendo del tipo de acabado que se quiera realizar, el secado o incluso el lavado de bandejas y ollas con mayor suciedad.En este último aspecto, el lavavajillas dispone de un inyector/aspersor (Deepwash) adicional pensado para el lavado de menaje, que si bien es un plus, no termina de realizar un trabajo óptimo sino se hace un prelavado manual con anterioridad y se elimina la suciedad más incrustada.Otro aspecto a reseñar es el estético. Con un acabado exterior inoxidable cepillado bastante logrado y embellecedores de plástico gris, que remata un display táctil muy intuitivo y que en el caso de mi unidad no ha dado ningún problema al pulsarlo, salvo los que indica el manual por el caso de incompatibilidad de funciones y programas.Señalar en este sentido que no todos los programas son compatibles con todas las funciones y que no todas las funciones se pueden activar a la vez, incluyendo la función de la apertura de puerta automática al finalizar el lavado, que tampoco está disponible en todos los programas.En cuanto al acabado interior, cuenta con una cubeta de acero inoxidable correcta, con un aspersor inferior pensado para llegar a todos los rincones del aparato y un aspersor superior ancho, que realiza bien su labor.Que cuente con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos es algo a lo que en principio éramos reacios, pero que ha terminado por resultarnos muy práctico por la limpieza que obtiene en la cubertería y el hueco que deja libre en la cesta inferior para optimizar el espacio al no llevar el típico cestillo de cubiertos.Pero en lo relativo a la disposición de las bandejas, aunque regulable en altura la superior, sí hemos notado que no caben o lo hacen con dificultad las copas de vino de cierta envergadura, en las que la bandeja de cubiertos impiden que éstas entren como deberían.En lo que sí debería mejorar Beko, sin duda, es los controles de calidad, ya que nuestra unidad venía con un pequeño golpe en el lateral derecho superior, que además venía marcado con rotulador negro, como si efectivamente hubiera pasado esos controles y le hubieran dado el 'visto bueno' pero con esta pequeña tara, que aunque no interfieren en el funcionamiento del aparato y queda totalmente escondido por la encimera de la cocina, sí que resulta extraño para el comprador encontrarse este tipo de cosas.No obstante, obviando estos pequeños defectos, el lavavajillas lo considero totalmente recomendable por ahora, a la espera de ver cómo resiste el paso del tiempo.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is great at cleaning typical dirty dishes.
Comments (English): This dishwasher is great at cleaning typical dirty dishes. Do not have to rinse off dishes in the sink before placing in dishwasher (as needed for previous washers). Love the silverware tray! Home Depot install issues were: my 30 year-old plumbing was no longer to code ANYMORE (1 valve worked fine for 2 previous washers) so had to hire a plumber to add another valve before install (additional $180). 2nd installer said I had to remove some floor tile before install (why didn't 1st installer tell me this? ). 3rd installer showed up with a Fridge! 4th installer was in such a hurry he did not fit the washer very well into the cabinetry; I had to redo the fitment myself. Next time I will install the washer myself! We do like the dishwasher very much.

Sentence (English): My Bosch Model SHS843AF5N was delivered three days ago, but I waited several days before removing it from its packaging because I was waiting for an installation kit (i.e., braided stainless steel supply line and 90-degree elbow) I had ordered with the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Does not include sound insulation shown in photo! ] || ---------------- || My Bosch Model SHS843AF5N was delivered three days ago, but I waited several days before removing it from its packaging because I was waiting for an installation kit (i.e., braided stainless steel supply line and 90-degree elbow) I had ordered with the dishwasher. Upon removing the dishwasher packaging, I was shocked and extremely disappointed to discover it did not include the cotton sound insulation that covers the top and sides of the dishwasher, which is clearly shown in the 360- degree photo of this dishwasher at Lowe's website. Every other model of Bosch dishwasher, including the lower-priced Ascenta and 100 Series dishwashers, come with cotton sound insulation to reduce the sound of the dishwasher. Bosch even touts this "extra layer of insulation' at its website as one of the 18 sound-reducing technologies found in Bosch dishwashers. Apparently, this particular model of Bosch dishwasher -- Model SHS843AF5N -- which is sold exclusively by Lowe's, does not include the cotton sound insulation found in all other Bosch dishwashers. As a result, it is much louder than the 48 dbA represented by Lowe's. It is even louder than the lower-priced Bosch Ascenta and 100 Series, which come with the cotton sound insulation. I would never have purchased this "Lowe's exclusive" model of Bosch dishwasher if I had know it did not include the cotton sound insulation. The photo of this model at Lowe's website is very misleading because it clearly shows cotton sound insulation covering the top and sides of the dishwasher. Shame on Lowe's! Unfortunately, I just learned I cannot return this dishwasher because major appliances can only be returned within 48 hours after delivery. I did not even discover the cotton sound insulation was not included until I removed the dishwasher from its packaging three days after it was delivered.

Sentence (English): I had a KitchenAid (KA) for about 32 years.
Comments (English): [ Meh - Don't understand the Bosch hoopla ] || ---------------- || I had a KitchenAid (KA) for about 32 years. My last one,12 yrs old, literally had disintegrated racks. I researched Consumer Reports, spoke with friends, & was excited for a Bosch. Despite the horrific installation process, I was still excited. Sadly, I'm not impressed and excitement waned. It's VERY persnickety about loading and doesn't dry well. It's not as quiet as my old KA and the controls are definitely not intuitive. The 2 things I DO like: sealed heating elements (so if a plastic spoon drops, it doesn't melt) and, ODDLY ENOUGH, the layout of the 3rd (top) shelf. I was skeptical about loading/unloading silverware but I love it! No "spooning" of utensils, easy to load/unload, and no self-inflicted injury from a fork or knife when unloading from a little silverware bucket. But, if I had to buy a dishwasher again, I'd probably go back to KA and not buy from Home Depot either - install was a nightmare but I'll save that for another time. My 2 stars reflect only the usage of the Bosch dishwasher - not impressed.

Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for one year.
Comments (English): [ Faulty design; cheaply made ] || ---------------- || I have owned this dishwasher for one year. Overall it cleans adequately and has decent features. It's design, however, is utterly flawed. In the one year I have owned it, I have had to replace the wheels on the bottom rack with 20 replacements. There are 8 wheels on the bottom rack that constantly - I mean constantly - pop off. If you don't happen to notice, such as if they pop off while you are pushing the rack in to run the cycle, they will melt onto your bottom heating element and be ruined. See the photo; the wheels snap onto a cheap plastic \"hub\" that does very little to hold the wheels on the rack. Any weight whatsoever on the rack and they just pop off. After buying 20 replacements at my own expense over the first year of ownership, I am no longer buying them and just shoving the bottom rack in. I now have three left of the eight needed. When I say I hate this dishwasher for this reason, I mean I HATE it. In addition to that, the trim on the door is very cheaply made and constantly separates from the door (see photo). I have reglued it on three times in the past year, but the heat from the dryer (that is right by this area of the door on the inside) just continues to loosen the glue and the trim pulls off again. For a $900 dishwasher, this model is a piece of junk. Calling customer service was a lesson in futility. They wanted to charge me to send out a technician to see that the wheels pop off. I will never purchase another GE appliance after this experience.

Sentence (English): We have owned this dishwasher for about four months now and have been very satisfied with it.
Comments (English): [ Powerhouse of a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We have owned this dishwasher for about four months now and have been very satisfied with it. As a luxury appliance, this one doesn't disappoint. It has all the bells and whistles and wifi connectivity with intuitive controls both on the indoor panel and the app. The top level cutlery tray is a useful feature and is helpful for odd shaped items that may otherwise collect water. Adjustable middle rack is helpful. The stainless steel interior means no discoloration from things like tomato sauce. The design is a little different than what we are used to. As such we are still learning how to properly load the dishes, and we weren't used to the length of time it takes to run a load. With the sanitizer and extra dry settings it takes about 2 hours & 20 minutes to run the whole cycle. There is a 60 minute quick setting, as well as a rinse, a delicate, and a half load setting. Also be prepared to refill finish jet dry liquid regularly. I have washed long stem wine glasses with large pots and dirty plates etc and everything is always super clean and dry. This is our second Bosch dishwasher, a step up model which we only replaced for our kitchen remodel. Would totally recommend for anyone looking for a high end, superior functioning known brand appliance. Bosch is it!

Sentence (English): I should've read these user reviews before I made my purchase.
Comments (English): [ Don't believe the hype ] || ---------------- || I should've read these user reviews before I made my purchase. Recently bought this model to replace a ~15 year old Amana and I'm sorry I did. First, they make a big deal about the adjustable upper rack, but don't believe their marketing shtick – the machine is completely lacking in what I would call 'versatility.' And loading it is a daily battle. It's designed to fit certain items in certain places, and you're out of luck if your needs differ from that. Example: you can either wash your dinner plates OR your wine glasses, but you can't wash both in the same cycle. In the upper position, the rack is too close to the sprayer to fit tall wine glasses; in the lower position, dinner plates in the lower rack will hit the middle sprayer. Another example: the prongs in the lower rack are so close together and so tightly configured, it's virtually impossible to fit anything other than plates in the racks. Good luck fitting larger bowls or roasting or frying pans unless you want to remove the silverware baskets and wash all your silverware by hand. Ridiculous! And on top of all that, it doesn't dry the dishes properly, so we have to empty the contents all over our countertops so that they can dry before we put them away. The good news is I've learned my lesson: always read user reviews first. And never buy a Bosch dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We've had lots of fridges (used to live in a national disaster area).
Comments (English): [ It's a TARDIS (Think Dr. Who Call Box) ] || ---------------- || We've had lots of fridges (used to live in a national disaster area). This one is by far the best. When our last fridge died we had specific dimensions a new one had to fit in. This one fits great, but the big surprise was all the sneaky room on the inside that's been built into this fridge. Right now I have 4 half gallons of milk on one door shelf. Large pizza boxes with leftovers fit on a shelf. We're a multi-generation family with lots of special eating habits and all our special foods fit in the fridge. We've had it how for about six months--through the holiday season--all the turkey leftovers and meal prep fit. The only negative is the freezer compartment. It's a top drawer with ice maker then there's a big bottom drawer. The bottom drawer is just wide open space. Again, there are several adult eaters using this fridge and the freezer needs better method of grouping foods together. We find things migrate to the bottom of the freezer drawer so were doing deep dives to find what we're looking for. Design wise: The slim front water dispenser is attractive and a step above the one we had on the inside of the old fridge. It's hard to comment about pricing because when the old fridge died everyone was in the middle of inflation, supply chain problems, pandemic pricing.

After the wash is done, there is at least half of the pouch still in the compartment. I was advised to just put the detergent in the bottom of the dishwasher- but the door pops open about a half hour into the cycle and by that time I'd assume whatever I put at the bottom has already dissolved so it's rare all my dishes ever come out completely clean. Sentence (English): I have owned this dishwasher for one year.
Comments (English): [ Horrible design, cheaply made ] || ---------------- || I have owned this dishwasher for one year. Overall it cleans adequately and has decent features. It's design, however, is utterly flawed. In the one year I have owned it, I have had to replace the wheels on the bottom rack with 20 replacements. There are 8 wheels on the bottom rack that constantly - I mean constantly - pop off. If you don't happen to notice, such as if they pop off while you are pushing the rack in to run the cycle, they will melt onto your bottom heating element and be ruined. See the photo; the wheels snap onto a cheap plastic "hub" that does very little to hold the wheels on the rack. Any weight whatsoever on the rack and they just pop off. After buying 20 replacements at my own expense over the first year of ownership, I am no longer buying them and just shoving the bottom rack in. I now have three left of the eight needed. When I say I hate this dishwasher for this reason, I mean I HATE it. In addition to that, the trim on the door is very cheaply made and constantly separates from the door (see photo). I have reglued it on three times in the past year, but the heat from the dryer (that is right by this area of the door on the inside) just continues to loosen the glue and the trim pulls off again. For a $900 dishwasher, this model is a piece of junk. Calling customer service was a lesson in futility. They wanted to charge me to send out a technician to see that the wheels pop off. I will never purchase another GE appliance after this experience.

Comments (English): We bought this dishwasher in April. We were willing to spend money on a good dishwasher. This one was very quiet, but more importantly it was in stock. What we found is that the dishwasher is very quiet, but dishes need to be prewashed. We were ok with this. Unfortunately in the 9 months we have owned this dishwasher, it has been broken for about 2 months. The first issue was a leak detection warning. This happened about 2 months after purchase and the technician was able to fix it quickly. The next issue was that the springs on the door broke. So when this 'smart' dishwasher would open at the end of each cycle, the door would come crashing fully open. Most recently the dishwasher had a PC and a 7C error message. The repair tech was able to replace one motor, but has to order an additional part for the 7c error. I wish I would have bought the Bosch or Miele.

Sentence (English): Though installation was included with this appliance, that couldn't be arranged at my vacation home, so I got the full DIY experience.
Comments (English): Though installation was included with this appliance, that couldn't be arranged at my vacation home, so I got the full DIY experience. I'm slow – installation took nearly two days – but in the process, I cleaned up some of the messes and shortcuts taken by previous workers. Whirlpool's instructions, both printed and on-line videos, were among the best I've seen, and the range of adjustments accommodated an install space where nothing is level, plumb, or true. My wife heard plenty of colorful language with each new indignity, but there was nothing that couldn't be overcome. Once connected, I had several days' supply of soiled dishes with which to test my handiwork, and the dishwasher performed flawlessly from first use. Interior racks had a great deal of flexibility, and the removable silverware basket seemed comically large (easily twice the size of our previous appliance) – in addition to the accommodations on the thin top rack. Going forward, we'll probably use the smaller basket from the previous dishwasher (which was also a Whirlpool family product.) The interior tub is one-piece rotomolded plastic, which should remain reliable and leak free, though I can imagine the surface showing wear from pots or baking sheets that rub against it. The stainless-steel interior of the door is about the only visible surface that isn't plastic or plastic coated, and centered within it are the rinse aid reservoir and detergent dispenser (optimized for premeasured pods or dishwasher tablets.) The exterior is a flat slab of fingerprint-resistant stainless steel, interrupted only by a small blue LED (lit when a cycle is running), and a recessed grey plastic handle. Controls are on the top of the door, visible only when the appliance is open. The absence of a visible logo on the dishwasher face means that this is an excellent choice for kitchens with a mixed pedigree of major appliances. Controls offer a variety of options, trading off between cleaning & drying thoroughness, cycle time, and energy efficiency, though I can't remember the last time I used anything other than a “Normal” or a “Rinse and Hold” cycle. Cycle times are all considerably longer than previous generation dishwashers, with payoffs in reduced water and energy consumption, while getting the dishes impressively clean. Time really is on your side! The dry cycle eliminated the water that collects in the recessed punt of our plastic insulated tumblers – a feat that neither of our previous dishwashers could do. Don't retire your towel just yet, as some water remained in some other crevices. In use, this dishwasher is very quiet—quieter than the refrigerator, microwave oven, or the house HVAC system; even the convection fan in the range made more noise! The top (third) rack was our only disappointment, as only could not accommodate something as thick as a soup ladle or the air fry basket from our range, and flatware or cutlery placed horizontally was more likely to be water spotted – but this is more a missed opportunity than a failing. In summary, this is a very good mid-priced dishwasher from a manufacturer that makes reliable and easily serviced products. I'm glad it's found a home in my home.

Sentence (English): Decided to go for a Bosch due to many people online recommending the brand.
Comments (English):
Decided to go for a Bosch due to many people online recommending the brand. So far I'm happy. It really is quiet and the red floor light during operation is a nice touch.
As much as I love smart home stuff, I didn't actually care for the WiFi implementation, but it had it, so I used it. They've actually done a good job here and offer you the ability to download new cycles, or even create personalised ones based on cleaning/temperature/time preferences. The phone notification for when it's finished cleaning is handy too, so you know when to open the dishwasher and let it air out/dry.
The lower tray has plenty of wide plate inserts too, something we struggled to find on other dishwashers (our plates have ridges at the edge, rather than tapering like most plates).
Installation was easy enough, though I think they need to improve the front door panel fitting system. It seems over engineered and too fiddly. Having the ability to adjust the rear foot from the front is a great addition too. Should be standard on every machine.
All in all a great machine, if a tad more expensive than the competition. I paid more hoping it will last longer though. So we shall see.

Comments (English): [ Disappointed with the service from Good Guys ] || ---------------- || I recommend the dishwasher, but not to buy it through the Good Guys. We purchased this dishwasher online from The Good Guys. It was not delivered on the date they had scheduled for delivery. They didn't notify us of any changes, we had to phone them to enquire. Every time we phoned them it was over an hour wait on the phone. They told us they 'forgot' to put the dishwasher on the delivery truck. We had paid for the dishwasher & installation of the product. However they could not book the install until we had the dishwasher, so again another hour waiting on the phone to book an install. We had to wait a further 2 weeks for delivery because of their first delivery error. So we had to reschedule the install, no availability for another 2-3 weeks. Finally had it installed. Worked 3 times then got an error code. Had to get a technician out - another 2 week wait. Technician informed us that the installation was done incorrectly causing a kink in the hose preventing proper water flow to the dishwasher. Finally we have a working dishwasher which is great. But the effort it took to get it here was not worth purchasing through The Good Guys.

Sentence (English): This super-sensing warehouse from Siemens really moved me.
Comments (English): This super-sensing warehouse from Siemens really moved me. I have always wanted to own a dishwasher, but because there is no space for a dishwasher in the cabinets of the hardcover room at home, I was told by the master that I could not buy a dishwasher for the first time. Installation, but the new super-sensing warehouse in September this year reduces the occupied height, realizing the possibility of installing a large-capacity dishwasher under the stove. I have always trusted Siemens appliances. The refrigerator and washing machine are all Siemens. This dishwashing machine The machine has a very good appearance and is very smart. You can control and check the dishwashing status on your mobile phone. The installer was very serious and responsible. Because of the need to remodel the cabinets, he spent two or three hours at my house and didn't go back until about 1:00 in the evening. It was really hard work. The only dissatisfaction now is that the separate development of the door panel and the machine caused the master to come twice. The dishwasher cannot be installed at one time. I can't understand why the door panel is delivered after the machine receives the goods, which makes the installation progress delayed for several days. Overall, I am quite satisfied. At present, only the default washing has been carried out for the first time, and the specific cleaning effect will be reviewed later.
Comments (Original): 西门子的这款超感仓真的让我好感动心心念念一直想拥有洗碗机，但由于家里精装房配的橱柜没有预留洗碗机空间，导致第一次购置洗碗机时被师傅告知无法安装，但今年九月的新品超感仓减少了占用高度，实现了灶台下安装大容量洗碗机的可能性西门子的电器我一直都很信任，冰箱洗衣机都是西门子的，这款洗碗机颜值很高，非常智能，可以在手机上操控并查看洗碗情况。安装师傅非常认真负责，由于要进行橱柜改造，在我家弄了两三个小时，大概晚上**点才回去，真的很辛苦。现在唯一不满意的是门板和机器分开发导致师傅来了两次，洗碗机不能一次性装好，理解不了为什么要机器收货了再发门板，搞得安装进度拖了好几天。整体还是挺满意的，目前仅进行了首次开机空仓默认洗，具体清洗效果等之后追评。

Then I found someone else complaining about it and they seemed to think it was due to the high heat. I think they compared to the scum that builds up in fish tanks. Sentence (English): LG Dishwasher is good, but not great.
Comments (English): LG Dishwasher is good, but not great. It's quiet but it runs for a long time. Seems to clean well which is the most important thing. Use the Extra dry feature every time, which adds more time, but it's needed. 3rd rack is mostly useless because not enough room (height) to fit things. The bottom rack has large basket with plenty of room for utensils, tools, and silverware. As directions say, you have to use two hands to pull out the bottom rack- which no one does. You can however use one hand (like a normal person) if place in the center and pull out straight and slowly. Otherwise the bottom rack will come off the track. Middle rack doesn't have this problem, and can adjust the middle rack height if needed, which is a nice feature. Lastly, when you completely close the dishwasher door it makes a loud crack noise when the plastic parts snap together. Will sound like you broke it. Our LG washing machine does same thing when you open it so I guess it's normal. 4 stars.

First world problem though - it beeps when it finishes.

I am also quite surprised that the door does not stay open a few inches after a wash to let it dry out. Instead, it slams shut unless it's open quite a bit or left entirely open. Since my cat likes to peek in, I am afraid it will slam shut and cut his paws or head off! Since my kitchen is small, leaving the door wide open is not an option. Other than these issues, I would recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I own the predecessor of this model and it failed with the same fault 3x in 4 years.
Comments (English): I own the predecessor of this model and it failed with the same fault 3x in 4 years. Do check whether this model has a different kind of heat pump before purchase if you live in a hardwater area.I purchased in Sept 2016 and set hard water to max as we are in a very chalky area. It is only used 2-3 times a week and we originally used it on the eco setting which did tend to leave chalky deposits that needed periodic cleaning.The heat pump first failed in January 2020 after just over 4 years of use. The heating element in the predecessor model is a tube that the water flows through, but because the water doesn't fill the tube any surplus evaporates on the top of the element, leaving any residual chalk behind. This builds up and causes a pump burn-out. The warranty (5 years) repair technician said the fault is so common that this heat pump design is no longer used - it is not fit for purpose - so do ask about this.The technician advised using the non-eco settings to flush the internal dishwasher deposits more effectively, but this uses more heat.18 months later, the new pump burned out again. Although just outside warranty, this was again replaced by Siemens as a goodwill gesture. Again, the heat pump had failed due to chalk build up.It's now January 2023 and the pump has failed again, this time 16 months after replacement. Now Siemens refuses to repair and we are outside the 6 years for a consumer action against the retailer (the product is clearly not fit for purpose in a hard water area).In summary, this model's predecessor has a design fault requiring regular repair.Otherwise the dishwasher is pretty good. It has a stainless steel interior rather than plastic, reducing the risk of leakage, runs quietly and cleans well.

Sentence (English): Being my first experience with a dishwasher I wanted to wait a while before reviewing it.
Comments (English): Being my first experience with a dishwasher I wanted to wait a while before reviewing it. Discounted take on about 450 euros. For the installation I lost some time and some videos and images are sometimes not easily understandable. Washing is very quiet, I use it at night and the only noise I hear is the water draining. Dishwashing is quite good, even at low temperatures, the only drawback is that sometimes I find the bottom of the glasses stained with dots, I don't know if it's the tablet used at low temperatures, I still have to try liquid detergent. It is quite spacious and easy to use. Through the app you can find other types of washes and their consumption. I noticed little water consumption, we'll see about electricity. Overall it's a great dishwasher. I have other Bosch appliances and I have to say that this time too it was a good choice. Bosch never disappoints.
